mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/pacs/figures && cat > /tmp/gen_pacs_figures.py << 'PYEOF'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import numpy as np

# EMNLP style
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'Times'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 10,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
    'axes.grid': False,
})

# Colorblind-friendly (Okabe-Ito subset)
C_HIGH = '#0072B2'   # deep blue
C_MID  = '#E69F00'   # orange
C_LOW  = '#D55E00'   # vermillion
C_IMP  = '#0072B2'   # deep blue
C_RND  = '#CC79A7'   # pink-purple

# Data
sparsity = [0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30]
sp_labels = ['0.15', '0.20', '0.25', '0.30']

imp_high = [0.205, 0.333, 0.584, 0.596]
imp_mid  = [0.696, 1.548, 4.522, 7.467]
imp_low  = [2.627, 9.563, 30.903, 44.632]
imp_grad = [12.8, 28.7, 52.9, 74.9]

rnd_high = [0.161, 0.321, 3.002, 5.378]
rnd_mid  = [0.252, 0.456, 2.985, 5.886]
rnd_low  = [0.183, 0.592, 2.915, 3.777]
rnd_grad = [1.1, 1.8, 0.97, 0.70]

outdir = '/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/figures'

# ============================================================
# Figure 1: Hero Figure — Phase-Modulated Severity Gradient
# ============================================================
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.75, 2.8))

# Left: Grouped bars (log scale) — Importance-based
x = np.arange(len(sparsity))
width = 0.25

bars_h = ax1.bar(x - width, imp_high, width, color=C_HIGH, label='High Phase', zorder=2)
bars_m = ax1.bar(x, imp_mid, width, color=C_MID, label='Mid Phase', zorder=2)
bars_l = ax1.bar(x + width, imp_low, width, color=C_LOW, label='Low Phase', zorder=2)

ax1.set_yscale('log')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(sp_labels)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sparsity Level')
ax1.set_ylabel('Median Instability Index (log)')
ax1.set_title('Importance-Based Eviction')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
ax1.set_ylim(0.1, 100)

# Add value labels on low-phase bars
for i, v in enumerate(imp_low):
    ax1.text(x[i] + width, v * 1.15, f'{v:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7, color=C_LOW)

# Right: Gradient lines
ax2.plot(sp_labels, imp_grad, 'o-', color=C_IMP, label='Importance-based', markersize=6, zorder=2)
ax2.plot(sp_labels, rnd_grad, 's--', color=C_RND, label='Random', markersize=6, zorder=2)

ax2.set_xlabel('Sparsity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Phase Gradient (Low / High)')
ax2.set_title('Severity Gradient Across Strategies')
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)

# Annotate key points
ax2.annotate(f'74.9×', xy=(3, 74.9), xytext=(2.5, 65),
             fontsize=8, color=C_IMP, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_IMP, lw=1.2))
ax2.axhline(1, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)
ax2.text(0.05, 1.8, 'No gradient (1×)', fontsize=7, color='gray')

plt.tight_layout(w_pad=2.5)
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig1_severity_gradient.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig1_severity_gradient.png')
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {outdir}/fig1_severity_gradient.pdf')
print(f'Saved: {outdir}/fig1_severity_gradient.png')

# ============================================================
# Figure 2: Phase-Strategy Crossover Heatmap
# ============================================================
# Matrix: rows = (importance, random) x phases; cols = sparsity levels
# Better layout: 2 rows (strategies) x 4 cols (sparsity), 3 sub-cells per cell (phases)
# Actually: heatmap with rows = strategy×phase (6 rows), cols = sparsity (4 cols)

# Reshape: rows are strategy-phase combos, cols are sparsity levels
data = np.array([
    imp_high, imp_mid, imp_low,
    rnd_high, rnd_mid, rnd_low
])

row_labels = [
    'Imp: High Phase', 'Imp: Mid Phase', 'Imp: Low Phase',
    'Rnd: High Phase', 'Rnd: Mid Phase', 'Rnd: Low Phase'
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.2))

# Log-scale colormap for better visibility
log_data = np.log10(data + 0.01)
vmin, vmax = np.log10(0.1), np.log10(50)
cmap = plt.cm.YlOrRd

im = ax.imshow(log_data, cmap=cmap, aspect='auto', vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)

# Cell annotations with raw values + crossover markers
for i in range(data.shape[0]):
    for j in range(data.shape[1]):
        val = data[i, j]
        color = 'white' if log_data[i, j] > (vmin + vmax) * 0.65 else 'black'
        text = f'{val:.2f}' if val < 10 else f'{val:.1f}'
        ax.text(j, i, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5,
                color=color, fontweight='bold')

# Mark crossover cells (where random < importance for low phase)
# Crossover: imp > rnd in same phase-sparsity cell
for j in range(4):
    # Low phase crossover
    if imp_low[j] > rnd_low[j]:
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j-0.48, 2-0.48), 0.96, 0.96,
                     fill=False, edgecolor='#009E73', linewidth=2, linestyle='-'))
    # High phase crossover (imp < rnd = imp is safer)
    if imp_high[j] < rnd_high[j]:
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j-0.48, 0-0.48), 0.96, 0.96,
                     fill=False, edgecolor='#56B4E9', linewidth=2, linestyle='--'))

ax.set_xticks(range(4))
ax.set_xticklabels([f's={s}' for s in sp_labels])
ax.set_yticks(range(6))
ax.set_yticklabels(row_labels, fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlabel('Sparsity Level')
ax.set_title('Instability Index: Strategy × Phase Interaction')

# Horizontal separator between strategies
ax.axhline(2.5, color='white', linewidth=2.5)

# Colorbar with log ticks
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
cbar.set_label('Instability Index', fontsize=8)
tick_vals = [0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 50]
cbar.set_ticks([np.log10(v) for v in tick_vals])
cbar.set_ticklabels([str(v) for v in tick_vals])

# Legend for border markers
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import matplotlib.lines as mlines
green_line = mlines.Line2D([], [], color='#009E73', linewidth=2, linestyle='-',
                           label='Crossover: Imp > Rnd')
blue_line = mlines.Line2D([], [], color='#56B4E9', linewidth=2, linestyle='--',
                          label='Imp safer than Rnd')
ax.legend(handles=[green_line, blue_line], loc='lower right', fontsize=7,
          framealpha=0.9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig2_crossover_heatmap.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig2_crossover_heatmap.png')
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {outdir}/fig2_crossover_heatmap.pdf')
print(f'Saved: {outdir}/fig2_crossover_heatmap.png')

print('\nDone. All figures saved.')
PYEOF
